name: Sovereign's Gavel
ability: After you roll for a round of combat, you may spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to produce 2 additional hits.

name: Iron Claw Division
ability: DEPLOY: During the Commit Ground Forces step in a system adjacent to or containing a planet you control, you may spend 3 influence to commit 1 mech and 1 infantry from your reinforcements.

name: Concordia's Voice
ability: Non-fighter ships in this system roll 1 additional combat die if this system contains another player's command token.

name: Pactforged Sentinel
ability: Other players must spend 1 influence or destroy 1 unit they control in order to return a token from a system that contains exactly 1 of your mechs to their reinforcements.

name: Silent Edict
ability: At the end of a round of space combat involving this unit, you may discard 1 action card to assign 1 hit to a non-carrier ship in this system.

name: Vox Sentinels
ability: When you exhaust this unit's planet to vote, cast 2 additional votes.

name: Hammer of Silence
ability: This unit's PRODUCTION value equals the resource value of 1 planet you control in this unit's system.

name: Ironbound Guardian
ability: DEPLOY: After movement, you may remove 2 of your fighters or infantry from the space area of the active system to place 1 mech from your reinforcements with your units in the active system.

name: Replicator I
ability: This unit can only produce dreadnoughts or units that can be transported that are in the space area of this system.

name: Replicator II
ability: This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" action cards. This unit can only produce dreadnoughts or units that can be transported that are in the space area of this system.

name: Vaultbreaker
ability: When you gain control of a planet in this unit's system, gain 1 commodity.

name: Excavator
ability: Once per action, at the end of a tactical action, if a planet in the active system contains exactly 2 of your mechs, you may explore that planet.

name: Ultimate Evolution II
ability: When you would research or gain a technology, you may flip this card instead.

name: Ultimate Evolution III
ability: When this unit uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE, cancel an additional hit.

name: Warspawn Juggernaut II
ability: When you research or gain a technology, you may flip this card instead.

name: Warspawn Juggernaut III
ability: When this unit produces a hit, you may SUSTAIN DAMAGE to place infantry with this unit up to the number of hits produced.

name: The Astral Codex
ability: At the start of combat in this system, select 1 technology color. This unit rolls additional combat dice equal to the number of technologies you own of that color.

name: Rune-Bound Sentinel
ability: When you research a technology you may damage this unit to ignore any 1 prerequisite on that technology.

name: Queen's Fang
notes: This unit's extra dice are auto-calculated based on how many ground forces are in its space area, assuming the flagship is getting filled first.
ability: During your tactical actions, this unit rolls additional combat and unit ability dice equal to the number of ground forces it transported.

name: Hexan Stingers
ability: DEPLOY: After a player moves ships, if the active system contains a planet you control, pay 2 trade goods to replace 1 of your infantry in that system with a mech from reinforcements.

name: The Obsidian Mirror
ability: If this unit's system contains no planets, you may treat this unit's system as adjacent to all non-fracture systems that contain no planets. During movement, this ship may move before or after your other ships.

name: Acolyte of the Hollow
ability: DEPLOY: When you purge 1 or more components, place 1 mech from your reinforcements on a planet you control.

name: Reliquary Eternal
ability: This unit rolls a number of additional dice equal to the number of unlocked, unexhausted, and unpurged leader types in your play area.

name: Grave Robbers
ability: DEPLOY: When you exhaust an agent for its effect, place 1 mech on a planet you control.

name: The Sepulchral Crown
ability: This unit's system is always treated as a nebula.

name: Ghola
ability: When 1 or more dice are rolled, you may destroy this unit to increase the value of 1 die by 3.
notes: After rolling dice, the bot offers a button to destroy a Ghola. If a die can become a hit with +3, the highest eligible die produces 1 additional hit.

name: Aurelion
ability: The Aurelion Station token is also a ship that can be produced. While you control this unit, gain the Aurelion station card.

name: The Crypt
ability: Once per action, when a fighter is destroyed in a system containing or adjacent to this unit, place 1 control token on this card. Increase this unit's capacity by 2 for each control token on this unit.

name: Walking Mausoleum
ability: After a round of ground combat, you may destroy this unit to destroy 2 of your opponent's ground forces on that planet.

name: Graveyard I
ability: Once per action, if a unit in a system containing or adjacent to this unit is destroyed, gain 1 commodity, or you may produce 1 unit of the same type in this system, if able. Up to 4 fighters in this unit's system do not count against capacity.

name: Graveyard II
ability: Once per action, if a unit in a system containing or adjacent to this unit is destroyed, gain 1 commodity, and you may produce 1 unit of the same type in this system, if able. Up to 8 fighters in this unit's system do not count against capacity.

name: Old Glory
ability: At the start of combat in this unit's system, you may damage this unit to give up to 2 fighters in this system SUSTAIN DAMAGE until the end of that combat.
notes: There is no way to show which fighters are sustained, you will have to keep track. However, the manual assign and auto-assign don't offer fighter sustains past when 2 fighters are sustained.

name: Dragoons
ability: The first time this unit would be destroyed during each combat, it is not.

name: Flagbearer
ability: When this unit uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE, you may destroy it to cancel up to 4 additional hits your opponent produced.

name: Bulwark
ability: After you activate a system, you may give one ship in this unit’s system SUSTAIN DAMAGE until the end of that action.

name: Jumpstarter
ability: Apply +1 to the MOVE values of units that start their movement in this system if this unit does not move.

name: Dreg
ability: During the "Assign Hits" step of space combat, if this unit is in the space area of that system, you may damage this unit to produce 1 additional hit.

name: Fuel Cell I
ability: After you activate a system, destroy any number of your fighters; apply +1 to the move value of 1 ship during this action for every 4 fighters you destroy.

name: Fuel Cell II
ability: After you activate a system, destroy any number of your fighters to apply +1 to the move value of 1 of your ships during this action for every 2 fighters you destroy. This unit may move without being transported. Fighters in excess of your ships' capacity count against your fleet pool.

name: Mobile Mountain
ability: While you control this unit, gain the "Mobile Mountain" planet card.

name: Golem Dormant
ability:
At the end of the status phase, you may remove 3 of your mechs from the same planet to draw 1 random Stoneborn relic fragment.
UNLEASH: Return 2 red fragmentum tokens from your player sheet.

name: Golem Unleashed
ability: At the end of the status phase, you may remove 2 of your mechs from the same planet to draw 1 random Stoneborn relic fragment.

name: Stalactium I Dormant
ability: DEPLOY: At the start of your turn, you may purge 2 relic fragments to place 1 dreadnought in a system containing your ships.

name: Stalactium II Dormant
ability:
DEPLOY: At the start of your turn, you may purge 1 relic fragment to place 1 dreadnought in a system containing your ships. This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" Action Cards.
UNLEASH: Return 2 blue fragmentum tokens from your player sheet.

name: Stalactium II Unleashed
ability: DEPLOY: At the start of your turn, you may purge 1 relic fragment to place 1 dreadnought in a system containing your ships. This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" Action Cards.

name: The Ooze
ability: DEPLOY: At the end of movement in a system that contains your ships, you may discard 1 action card to place this unit in the active system. At the end of that tactical action, return this unit to your reinforcements.

name: Vacuole
ability: Action cards cannot be used during a combat in a system that contains at least 2 of your mechs.

name: Cytoplasmic Transports I
ability: Once per action, when you discard 2 or more action cards, you may either produce 1 carrier in a system containing your ships, or move 1 carrier you control to a system that contains 1 of your space docks (it may transport units).

name: Cytoplasmic Transports II
ability: Once per action, when you discard 1 or more action cards, you may either produce 1 carrier in a system containing your ships, or move 1 carrier you control to a system that contains 1 of your space docks (it may transport units).

name: Double Dragons
ability: DEPLOY: At any time, you may remove 2 structures from a planet you control in a system that contains your ships to place this unit from your reinforcements in that system.

name: Commensalists
ability: Your mechs have the text abilities of the mechs of each player you are currently coexisting with.
